caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object with symmetrical, vertically oriented arms that curve outward into spiral shapes at the top, resting on a rectangular block with a yellowish-brown color. The object is dark gray, with decorative incised patterns running up each arm and into the spirals, and includes a small heart-shaped cutout in the crossbar that connects the two arms. Below and to the left of the main perspective view, there are simplified front and top views of the same object, and to the lower right, there is a detailed view of the scrollwork pattern found on the spiral, presented as a circular motif. The background of the drawing is a plain cream color and the entire artwork is framed by a fine black border. The name "Francis Law Durand" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Foot Scraper
